verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no published memory-quality benchmark results for Zep, such as LongMemEval, LoCoMo or any recall-accuracy figures. The only performance claims are about latency (sub-200ms retrieval), which is a different axis from recall accuracy. Benchmarking is a fair question for a memory product, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published memory-quality benchmark results (e.g. LongMemEval, LoCoMo) backing the product's recall-accuracy claims
